task.description:
Task: cs-mail-legal-hold-four-eyes-approval-fd001-alignment.
Use existing worker-1 mail worktree /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker1-mail-context-20260520T115222Z after completed task 26 commit 895a4c0c. This lane is disjoint from messenger shared runtime bindings and ontology.
Scope: crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs plus exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-mail-legal-hold-four-eyes-approval-fd001-alignment-* and evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-legal-hold-four-eyes-approval-fd001-alignment.json only. No root manifests, contracts, registries, adapters, I/O, or policy docs.
Before editing read authority/context: specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, microservices/mail/IP-011-legal-hold-engine.md, IP-012-ediscovery-export.md, policy/dual-context-isolation.md, current crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs including StrictMailLegalHoldGuard and StrictMailRetentionSweepGuard, and one similar pure guard pattern in the repo. Run planning-closure start gate. Claim with Oya VCS as worker-1 intent "FD001 mail legal hold four-eyes approval" for crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs::MailLegalHoldApprovalGuard.
Implement a pure zero-I/O domain primitive for four-eyes legal-hold approval: approval actor model with distinct requester and approver, same tenant-governed context enforced through StrictMailLegalHoldGuard, requester cannot self-approve, approver must be distinct/non-empty, engage/release/export operations require valid two-person approval, plaintext disclosure/export requires explicit approval operation, deterministic MailError variants for invalid requester/approver/self-approval/missing approval, and tests covering engage success, release success, export/plaintext approval success, self-approval rejection, Personal-pillar rejection, cross-context rejection before approval, and invalid approver/requester rejection. Keep business logic in domain; no handler/adapters.
Verify: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain -- --nocapture; cargo nextest run -p oya-connect-mail-domain; cargo clippy -p oya-connect-mail-domain --all-targets -- -D warnings; planning-closure; data-class; architecture-boundaries; catalog; dependency-seam; oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote. Commit only scoped lib/evidence with Lore trailers.
